main_body: Tiled gabled roof with a half-timbered dormer, above a plastered half-timbered wall with a large double barn door and two small windows
top_band: Roof slope in orange/maroon tile rows 3-53 (a lit ridge row at rows 3-4, then alternating tile rows), ending in a dark eave row at 54-55
evidence: The roof reads as a large sloped surface seen from above, with a lit ridge, scalloped tile rows and a dormer set into it, just as in the Beodeul house references. Rows 53-55 give a lighter tile edge and then a dark eave shadow band over the wall. The wall below (rows 56-90) is a clear vertical south face with framed timbers, a recessed double door with a lintel, and windows with sills. Both the roof and the wall satisfy the contract, and no receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The roof tiles carry a per-tile highlight, a mid tone and a dark tone, plus a bright ridge row. The plaster has speckle dots, and the wood door has grain, planks and iron studs. The outline is a dark brown/maroon tint (1% neutral dark edge pixels). The candidate has 21 colours per tile against 18 and 11 for the references, with 0% flat-fill coverage. It is comparable to the references in craft and structure.
